name: What are the repair options for damaged cast iron drain pipes?

mainEntity.name: What are the repair options for damaged cast iron drain pipes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repair options for damaged cast iron drain pipes depend on the extent and location of the damage. For minor cracks or leaks, trenchless pipe lining, which involves inserting a resin-coated liner into the existing pipe, can create a new, durable pipe within the old one without extensive digging. For more severe damage or collapsed sections, traditional dig-and-replace methods may be necessary. CG Plumbing Solutions assesses each situation to recommend the most effective and least disruptive solution for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair options range from trenchless pipe lining for minor damage to traditional dig-and-replace methods for severe issues.
